title: Every user who can see any other Performance report also sees Sales By Representative
custom_preconds:
1. A test user exists whose role can see another Performance-group report (create/assign a ZZAUTOTEST role if needed; restore afterwards).
2. You are signed in as that user.
custom_steps: 1. Open the Reports navigation and read the Performance group.
custom_expected: 1. "Sales By Representative" appears in the Performance group for this user — the entry is visible to every user who can see any other report in the same group.
